events.summary: 塔拉辛驾狼形小艇撞毁卡利纳特号舷外支架的控制台，瘫痪舵与以太波收发器，随后在甲板上遭到船员围攻。
events.quote: The wolf slammed through the outrigger’s control panels, knocking its operators aside, effectively disabling the rudders and the aetherwave transceiver and the ebb and flow of the Squallfast currents.

events.summary: 她带伤近战，旧伤裂开，左手仍下意识地试图凝出光织护盾却落空——魔力已失。
events.quote: The wound in her thigh opened up as she stabbed and slashed, as she dodged and counterattacked.

events.summary: 一名敌兵颤抖着唤她“拉奇斯卡”，她由此明白士兵迟疑不是怕光织，而是怕她本人。
events.quote: A new sword clashed against hers and she looked into the eyes of its wielder. The man was trembling.

events.summary: 拉詹·班特格拨开人群上前，拔剑声称要亲手为达雅·穆萨尔与拉詹·吉塔布复仇。
events.quote: He drew his sword. “It is only right that I avenge Daya Musal and Rajan Gitab with my own hands.”

events.summary: 她反问为何不提达雅·费拉萨伊，班特格答不知其意，令她怀疑奥里亚尔未死。
events.quote: Talasyn scoffed. “I’m sure Daya Ferasai would have minded being left out of the equation.”

events.summary: 云开，“拯救号”现身；其左舷闪电炮齐发，击穿包抄胡克特拉的敌军舰队。
events.quote: The lightning cannons on the port side discharged, waves of brilliant white heat coursing through nearly all of the enemy vessels that had outflanked the Huktera.

events.summary: 她喝令班特格下跪，班特格弃剑屈膝，众兵随之投降。
events.quote: Banteg’s sword clattered onto the wooden planks. He dropped to his knees before Talasyn, and his soldiers were quick to follow.

relations.claim: 敌对但非私仇：她声明只与主谋作战，愿以招降换取情报；他坚持为同伴复仇并拒绝求饶。
relations.quote: “Rajan Banteg,” Talasyn said coolly. “My fight is not with your men.”

relations.pair: 塔拉辛—卡利纳特号船员
relations.claim: 船员因畏惧“光织”与她“后继者”的身份而迟疑，这份畏惧反而保住了她的命。
relations.quote: That was probably the only thing saving her life—their fear of the Lightweave. It made most of them hesitate before striking.

relations.pair: 塔拉辛—乌尔杜雅·希利姆
relations.claim: 祖孙兼君臣：她是扎希亚-拉奇斯的继承人，故士兵在效忠本家与效忠王权之间撕裂。
relations.quote: Because Talasyn was She Who Would Come After. She was Urduja Silim’s heir.

relations.claim: 夫妻兼师徒：他教她为自己愤怒，此刻正于风暴眼中俯视并等待她。
relations.quote: Alaric had taught her that. He was watching her from the sky above. He was waiting for her in the eye of the storm.

relations.pair: 塔拉辛—达雅·奥里亚尔（费拉萨伊）
relations.claim: 生死未明的旧敌/旧识：班特格未提她，令塔拉辛怀疑其尸体不在死者之中。
relations.quote: She stared at him. Had Oryal’s body not been among the dead, back there on that crimson-glossed mountain?

numbers.quote: There was that same hesitation rippling through them, multiplied a hundred times over.
There was a burst of static from Talasyn’s wolf coracle, lying on its side several feet away.
setting off chain reactions that resulted in dozens of miniature explosions.
The turmoil of the last several hours—the physical toll, the emotional upheaval—it all pressed against the backs of her eyes.
